connector.name: Mosaic Pre-Clinical Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Pre-clinical drug discovery intelligence - targets, compounds, patents, trials, whitespace
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mosaic-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sourabhnk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL/Neon connection string for the Mosaic knowledge graph (must end /mosaic_db)

env.name: MOSAIC_API_KEY
env.description: API key that unlocks the 28 Pro tools (optional; free tier works without it)

env.name: MOSAIC_TIER
env.description: Override tier for local dev: free (default), pro, or enterprise
